title: UPSC Prelims 2026 TOMORROW - Final Exam Day Guidelines, Gate Closes 9 AM, What to Carry
author: Ash K.
summary: UPSC CSE Prelims 2026 is tomorrow, May 24 (Sunday). GS Paper I 9:30-11:30 AM, CSAT 2:30-4:30 PM. Gate closes 9:00 AM sharp - reach by 8:30 AM. Carry: 2 printed admit cards, original photo ID, black ballpoint pen. Do NOT carry phone. 13 lakh candidates appearing for 933 posts.
body: UPSC Civil Services Preliminary Examination 2026 is TOMORROW - Sunday, May 24, 2026. Over 13 lakh candidates will appear for 933 IAS/IPS/IFS posts across exam centres in India.

DetailInformation
Exam DateMay 24, 2026 (Sunday)
Paper I (GS)9:30 AM – 11:30 AM
Paper II (CSAT)2:30 PM – 4:30 PM
Gate ClosesMorning: 9:00 AM | Afternoon: 2:00 PM
Reach Centre By8:30 AM (30 min before gate close)
Total Posts933 (IAS/IPS/IFS + other services)
Candidates13+ lakh
Paper I100 MCQs × 2 marks = 200 marks
Paper II80 MCQs × 2.5 marks = 200 marks
Negative Marking1/3 of allotted marks per wrong answer
CSAT Qualifying33% (66/200)
PenBlack ballpoint pen ONLY
BANNED ItemsMobile, smartwatch, calculator, Bluetooth, bags

TONIGHT CHECKLIST (do these NOW): (1) Print 2 copies of admit card. (2) Keep original photo ID ready - same as on admit card. (3) Pack: 2-3 black ballpoint pens, transparent water bottle, analog watch, light lunch for between papers. (4) Set 2 alarms for 6:30 AM. (5) Sleep by 10 PM. No studying after this point.

Gate timing is strict: Morning shift gate closes at 9:00 AM. Afternoon shift gate closes at 2:00 PM. Late entry is NOT allowed under any circumstances - even 1 minute late means you miss the exam. Plan for traffic, rain, or any delays. Reach by 8:30 AM.

What to carry: Printed admit card (2 copies). Original photo ID (Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID/Passport - whichever is mentioned on admit card). Black ballpoint pen (2-3 pens). Transparent water bottle. Analog watch. Light snack/lunch for between papers.

What NOT to carry: Mobile phone - leave it at HOME, not in your bag. Smartwatch, fitness band. Calculator. Bluetooth earpiece. Books, notes, loose papers. Any electronic device. Bags (some centres don't allow). Exam centres have NO safe storage.

Paper I approach: You have 120 minutes for 100 questions. First pass (60 min) - attempt only questions you're sure about. Second pass (40 min) - attempt where you can eliminate 2+ options. Final 20 min - review OMR sheet. Target: 65-75 attempts with 80%+ accuracy.

Between papers: Don't discuss Paper I answers - it changes nothing and kills confidence. Eat lunch. Rest 30 minutes. Light CSAT formula revision if needed. CSAT needs 33% (66/200) - focus on reading comprehension first.
For full UPSC preparation resources, check our UPSC CSE exam guide.

faqs.question: What time does the UPSC Prelims gate close tomorrow?
faqs.answer: Morning shift gate closes at 9:00 AM sharp. Afternoon shift at 2:00 PM. No late entry allowed. Reach by 8:30 AM.

faqs.question: Can I carry my phone to UPSC Prelims?
faqs.answer: No. Leave your mobile phone at HOME - not in your bag or vehicle. All electronic devices including smartwatches are strictly banned. No safe storage at centres.

faqs.question: What pen should I use for UPSC Prelims OMR?
faqs.answer: Black ballpoint pen only. Not blue, not gel pen, not pencil. Carry 2-3 black ballpoint pens.

faqs.question: What is CSAT qualifying marks?
faqs.answer: 33% - which is 66 out of 200 marks. CSAT is qualifying only. Only Paper I marks count for merit and cutoff.

faqs.question: How many questions should I attempt in Paper I?
faqs.answer: Target 65-75 questions with high accuracy (80%+). Each wrong answer costs 0.67 marks. Don't attempt all 100 unless you're confident.

callout.heading: EXAM TOMORROW - Sleep Now, Study Later
callout.content: Stop studying NOW. Pack your admit card, ID, and pens. Set 2 alarms. Eat light dinner. Sleep by 10 PM. Reach centre by 8:30 AM. Gate closes 9:00 AM - no exceptions. Good luck.
